resources.string: When the game starts with the controllers connected now: %1$s.

Port %1$d is player %1$d in the game. Left and right choose a controller for it; First come gives it to the next one, in the order they are connected (the built-in pad first). A controller that disconnects keeps its port until it comes back.

Both sticks, the D-pad, A B X Y, Black and White, the triggers, Back and Start, and the stick presses (LS, RS) on the game\'s screen. Without a controller: shown while no controller is connected, hidden as soon as one is used. Never on a handheld\'s top screen while the bottom screen shows the panel.
How much of the game shows through the on-screen pad.
The size of the on-screen pad\'s controls.

Move, resize or hide the on-screen pad\'s controls for %1$s games: left and right choose the console, A opens the editor. Your layout keeps its place at any screen resolution; until you save one, the usual layout stays.
Drag a control to move it. Select one, then pinch with a second finger or use − and + to resize it.
Not saved: keep a D-pad or stick and at least one face button visible.
Removes every saved on-screen pad layout, for all consoles and every game: the usual layout comes back.
Touch pad hidden: a controller is connected. Tap the game screen to show it, or see Settings › Controls › On-screen pad › Show.
Touch pad hidden while the bottom screen shows the panel. Tap the game screen to show it.
The on-screen pad cannot reach the game (native call missing). Share the log from the in-game menu.
